description: This file defines the EndpointProxy class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Report API plugin. The class extends the Endpoint class and mainly provides inherited methods related to request handling, parameters, validation, and sorting/pagination for report endpoint proxies.

classes.name: EndpointProxy
classes.description: A proxy class extending Endpoint to handle report-specific API interactions within the OrangeHRM HRM system, mainly providing inherited request and parameter handling.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current Request object, inheriting behavior from the parent Endpoint class.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Returns the current RequestParams object, inheriting behavior.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Returns the ValidationDecorator for validation logic, inherited from parent.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Sets or retrieves sorting and pagination parameters based on given FilterParams and optional default sort field, inherited method.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Provides rules for sorting and pagination parameters, based on allowed sort fields and exclusion flag, inherited from parent.
